description.narrative: Industrial estates are critical drivers of industrialization. The proposed project will support Tripura's industrial infrastructure development. The state government has prioritized the development of nine industrial estates with ADB's support. The project builds on due diligence and preparation completed under a $2.0 million project readiness financing (PRF) loan to develop integrated, inclusive, climate-resilient, and sustainable infrastructure at the industrial estates. The project is aligned with the following impact: boost manufacturing sector's competitiveness, enhance product diversification, promote job creation and foster regional cooperation.

description.narrative: Improved industrial infrastructure

At least 5% increase in number of women-led SMEs from Tripura registered in Udyam Registration Portal (URP) of the Ministry of MSME, GOI. (2024 baseline: 124) Progress/Status: The State Government is organizing Road shows, Investment Summits, Business Enclaves etc. at various cities to attract investment in the State including women entrepreneurs. Besides, there is provision for special incentives Scheme, 2022 for women investor. Data Source: Reports published by TIDCL, Industry and Commerce Department GOT. Actual value:

Exports of good and commodities increased by at least 10% (FY 2024 baseline: $1.5 million). Progress/Status: Due to election process in Bangladesh, initially export of goods and commodities suffered some difficulties. However, Exports of goods and commodities is recovering slowly. Data Source: Reports published by TIDCL, Industry and Commerce Department GOT. Actual value:

Employment in 9 industrial estates increased by 15%, with 35% of jobs attributed to women workers. (2024 Baseline: share of women in industrial estates is 29%). Progress/Status: Will be achieved in a phased manner. A new condition will be included in lease deed that all allottees will employ at least 33% women worker in line with State Policy for Empowerment of Women, 2022. Data Source: Reports published by TIDCL, Industry and Commerce Department GOT. Actual value:

At least 65% of available industrial land allocated to private investors in 9 industrial estates developed and upgraded (FY2024 Baseline: 40%). Progress/Status: At present more than 90% of the land is allotted to private investors only. Few plots have allotted to Govt. institution like Forest Department (for Agar processing), ESIC hospitals, IOCL, CCIL etc. .Thus, all land are used for industrial purpose only. Data Source: Reports published by TIDCL, Industry and Commerce Department GOT. Actual value:
